nodes.name: Hydrothermal Synthesis of NiFe LDH Series
nodes.procedure: 1.28 mmol of Ni(NO₃)₂·6H₂O, 0.22 mmol of FeSO₄·H₂O, 3 mmol of urea and xg cinnamic acid (x = 0, 0.01, 0.03, 0.05, 0.07) were dissolved in 20 mL of ultrapure water to form a light green solution under magnetic stirring. The pH was adjusted to 10 by adding appropriate amount of NaOH. Subsequently the reaction solution and NF were reacted in a high-pressure reaction vessel with a capacity of 25 mL for 8 h at 120°C. After natural cooling, the resulting pieces were rinsed multiple times with ethanol and water. Finally, the samples underwent a drying process at 60°C for 4 h. The resulting products were labeled as NiFe LDH, NiFe LDH—CNA1, NiFe LDH—CNA2, NiFe LDH—CNA3, and NiFe LDH—CNA4.

nodes.source_text: According to our previous research [27], NiFe LDH and NiFe LDH—CNAs were prepared using the conventional hydrothermal method. 1.28 mmol of Ni(NO₃)₂·6H₂O, 0.22 mol of FeSO₄·H₂O, 3 mmol of urea and xg cinnamic acid (x = 0, 0.01, 0.03, 0.05, 0.07) were dissolved in 20 mL of ultrapure water... Finally, the samples underwent a drying process at 60°C for 4 h.

nodes.description: OER performance in 1 M KOH electrolyte
nodes.source_text: The electrochemical performance of all samples in a 1 M KOH electrolyte was thoroughly investigated... NiFe LDH—CNA3 sample exhibits superior OER catalytic performance, which requires only overpotentials as low as 247 mV to achieve current densities as high as 50 mA/cm2. Meanwhile, the overpotentials at 50 and 100 mA/cm2 of these samples are specifically shown in Fig. 5b... Tafel slope of NiFe LDH... 70.6 mV/dec... mass activity (14.4 A·g⁻¹)... Cdl of NiFe LDH (0.99 mF/cm2)... After 72 h, the performance of NiFe LDH showed a small weakening... maintained 94.2%

nodes.description: OER performance in 1 M KOH electrolyte
nodes.source_text: NiFe LDH—CNA3 sample exhibits superior OER catalytic performance, which requires only overpotentials as low as 247 mV to achieve current densities as high as 50 mA/cm2... Tafel slope of NiFe LDH-CNA3 was only 41.8 mV/dec... maximum mass activity (68.2 A·g⁻¹)... highest Cdl of 1.91 mF/cm2... TOF of NiFe LDH—CNA3 is 0.195 s⁻¹ under 270 mV overpotential... NiFe LDH—CNA3 maintained the initial potential well, and the OER performance was maintained 99.2%

nodes.description: OER performance in alkaline seawater (1 M KOH + real seawater)
nodes.source_text: It displays an outstanding OER performance with 247 mV and 258 mV to achieve the current density of 50 mA/cm2 in 1 M KOH electrolyte and alkaline seawater (1 M KOH + real seawater)... CNA-NiFe LDH presents excellent durability (over 72 h at 100 mA/cm2) in 1 M KOH electrolyte and alkaline seawater... long-term oxygen evolution efficiency of NiFe LDH—CNA3 in alkaline seawater electrolytes remained almost unchanged at 95.8%

nodes.description: OER stability in alkaline seawater (1 M KOH + real seawater) at 100 mA/cm2
nodes.source_text: NiFe LDH exhibited poor stability in alkaline seawater electrolytes, with the performance weakening by 15.8% after 72 h

nodes.description: Faradaic efficiency in three electrolytes at 100 mA/cm2
nodes.source_text: The Faraday efficiency of NiFe LDH—CNA3 at different electrolytes was evaluated using the gas collection method... The gas production at both anode and cathode of NiFe LDH—CNA3 under three different electrolytes is comparable to the theory, and the Faraday efficiency is near 100%

nodes.characterization_summary: NiFe LDH and NiFe LDH—CNAs show diffraction peaks at 12.0°, 23.1°, 34.3°, 39.0°, and 46.3° corresponding to (003), (006), (012), (015), and (018) planes of Ni0.75Fe0.25(-CO3)0.125(OH)2·0.38H2O. The (003) peak shifts to lower angles with increasing CNA loading, expanding interlayer spacing from 7.38 Å to 7.96 Å.
nodes.evidence_snippet: A series of diffraction peaks (marked with red diamond symbols) are observed in the vicinity of 12.0°, 23.1°, 34.3°, 39.0°, and 46.3° for these as-prepared samples, corresponding to the (003), (006), (012), (015), and (018) crystal planes of Ni0.75Fe0.25(-CO3)0.125(OH)2·0.38H2O ... the interlayer spacing of NiFe LDH has been calculated to expand from 7.38Å to 7.96Å

nodes.characterization_summary: NiFe LDH shows peaks at 455 and 528 cm⁻¹ (Eg bending and A1g stretching of M-O) and 1050 cm⁻¹ (C-O of CO₃²⁻). NiFe LDH-CNAs show new bands at 985 and 1629 cm⁻¹ (C=C of CNA) and 1578 cm⁻¹ (RCOO⁻ asymmetric stretching), intensifying with CNA loading.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The spectrum of NiFe LDH shows two strong peaks at 455 and 528 cm⁻¹, which are attributed to the Eg bending mode and A1g stretching mode of M-O bond ... With the insertion of CNA, new bands appear at 985 and 1629 cm⁻¹ in NiFe LDH-CNAs, corresponding to the stretching vibration of the C = C double bond in CNA

nodes.characterization_summary: NiFe LDH shows M-O at 646 and 449 cm⁻¹, CO₃²⁻ interaction at 509 cm⁻¹, C-O at 1073 and 1373 cm⁻¹, OH at 3348-3606 cm⁻¹, H-O-H at 1621 cm⁻¹. NiFe LDH-CNAs show RCOO⁻ symmetric/asymmetric at 1384 and 1562 cm⁻¹, aromatic C-C at 1606 cm⁻¹.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The spectral bands in the vicinity of 646 and 449 cm⁻¹ can be ascribed to the lattice vibrations of M-O ... The strong absorption bands at 1384 cm⁻¹ and 1562 cm⁻¹ in the NiFe LDH-CNAs samples, correlated with the symmetric and asymmetric vibrations of the RCOO⁻ in the CNA intercalation

nodes.characterization_summary: NiFe LDH shows smooth nanosheets vertically staggered on NF. NiFe LDH—CNA3 nanosheets exhibit bending with CNA insertion.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The SEM image (Fig. 3a) shows smooth NiFe LDH nanosheets vertically staggered born on the NF substrate. The NiFe LDH—CNA3 nanosheets (Fig. 3d) exhibit different degrees of bending with the insertion of CNA.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiFe LDH and NiFe LDH—CNA3 show sheet structures. CNA insertion induces nanosheet exfoliation and ultrathin formation.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The TEM images exhibit the sheet structures of NiFe LDH (Fig. 3b) and NiFe LDH—CNA3 (Fig. 3e), and the insertion of CNA induces the nanosheet exfoliation and promotes the formation of ultrathin nanosheets.

nodes.characterization_summary: NiFe LDH shows lattice spacing of 2.30 Å ((018) plane). NiFe LDH—CNA3 shows 1.97 Å and 2.30 Å ((015) and (018) planes).
nodes.evidence_snippet: The HRTEM images (Fig. 3c and f) reveal the lattice spacings of approximately 1.97 and 2.30Å of NiFe LDH—CNA3 and NiFe LDH, corresponding to the typical NiFe LDH (PDF NO. 40-0215) with (015) and (018) crystal planes

nodes.characterization_summary: NiFe LDH—CNA3 nanosheet thickness is 1.24 nm vs 4.58 nm for pristine NiFe LDH, confirming exfoliation effect.
nodes.evidence_snippet: NiFe LDH—CNA3 exhibits nanosheet thickness about 1.24nm, which is much thinner than that of pristine NiFe LDH (4.58nm), confirming the exfoliation effect of CNA

nodes.characterization_summary: Uniform distribution of Ni, Fe, C, and O elements in NiFe LDH—CNA3.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The uniform distribution of Ni, Fe, C and O elements in NiFe LDH—CNA3 can be observed through the elemental mapping diagram (Fig. 3 g–k).

nodes.characterization_summary: NiFe LDH—CNA3 Fe 2p peaks at 712.7 eV (2p3/2) and 725.8 eV (2p1/2) for Fe³⁺. Ni 2p peaks at 855.5/857.1 eV (Ni²⁺/Ni³⁺ 2p3/2), 873.1/874.6 eV (2p1/2). Ni²⁺/Ni³⁺ ratio increases from 1.82 (NiFe LDH) to 2.11 (NiFe LDH—CNA3). Fe 2p3/2 positive shift of 0.2 eV with CNA.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The Fe 2p XPS spectrum (Fig. 4a) can be categorized into two characteristic peaks at 712.7eV and 725.8eV, which correspond with the 2p3/2 and 2p1/2 energy levels of Fe³⁺, respectively ... It can be obtained that the peak area ratio of Ni²⁺/Ni³⁺ increased from 1.82 to 2.11 with CNA intercalation. This may be due to the substitution of CO₃²⁻ with high charge density by CNA with low charge density ... The Fe 2p 3/2 peak displays a positive shift of 0.2 eV

nodes.characterization_summary: Type IV isotherms with H3 hysteresis. NiFe LDH: 129.1 m²/g, NiFe LDH—CNA3: 73.5 m²/g. Average pore size: NiFe LDH ~3.52 nm, NiFe LDH—CNA3 3.72 nm.
nodes.evidence_snippet: The specific surface areas of NiFe LDH and NiFe LDH—CNA3 ranged from 129.1 to 73.5m³/g, respectively ... the average pore size of NiFe LDH—CNA3 catalyst is 3.72nm, which is larger than the NiFe LDH (~3.52nm)
